topography.project_purpose: Cross Chain Bridge. Structurally: 11 project-authored contract(s) across 4 chain(s); 7 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 2 common project-authored base contract(s) (erc20burnable, proxy). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
